kill_chain_signals.contact: fraudsters send emails with victim's full name, telephone number, residential address and screenshot from search engines; automated calls to Asian community; fake profiles on social media and dating websites
kill_chain_signals.pretext: letter claims victim visited explicit websites; threatens arrest for criminal charges; claims computer hacked and explicit video recorded; claims to be law enforcement, CRA, immigration officials, or hydro company
kill_chain_signals.payment: demands payment via Bitcoin, cryptocurrency, gift cards (iTunes, Google Play, Steam), money service businesses, or QR codes; threatens to release video, turn off power, arrest, deport, or carry out violence
kill_chain_signals.movement: email provides Bitcoin address to send payment to; some letters use QR code for cryptocurrency payment
kill_chain_signals.cashout: payment requested in cryptocurrency and gift cards which are difficult to trace and recover

red_flags: threats of arrest, deportation, or violence unless immediate payment made
demands for payment via Bitcoin, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or QR codes
unsolicited contact claiming to be law enforcement or government agency
email contains personal information like passwords from previous data breaches
pressure to act immediately or face consequences
key_quote: Do not send money under pressure and do not reply to threatening messages.
